subcategory_text: Owners or operators (e.g., the organization or third parties such as service providers, partners, customers, and developers) and their roles with respect to the systems/products/services and components (e.g., internal or external) that process data are inventoried.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CM-8(4) (Accountability in System Component Inventory)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.19 (Information security in supplier relationships)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.AM-04 (asset owners identified)
implementation_examples: Identify and document the owners and operators of each system or component that processes personal data, whether internal (e.g., business unit) or external (e.g., service provider, partner)
Capture the contractual relationship, role (controller, processor, sub-processor), and the responsibilities each party has for the data they handle
Reconcile owners/operators against the data inventory and the third-party register to detect gaps
assessment_objectives: Determine whether owners/operators are identified for each inventory item
Determine whether the role (controller/processor) and contractual basis are recorded
Determine whether external parties are mapped to their respective inventory items
Determine whether ownership changes are reflected in the inventory on a defined cadence
